description: Direct table indexing introduces an unchecked out-of-range access in pack_trellis and unpack_trellis for unsupported K.
trigger: Call either native wrapper with K=9 and tensors satisfying its shape checks, including packed final dimension 144 and unpacked final dimension 256.
expected_behavior: Reject unsupported bitrate without accessing outside the specialization table.
actual_behavior: The new expression indexes element 8 of an eight-entry table. Existing shape checks do not reject this construction; the previous dispatch simply selected no kernel.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search finds both native bindings and a Python pack_trellis helper that forwards quant_args['K'] without a local range check. The unpack call in that helper is commented out. Reach is established for direct extension callers and this packing helper, not for every conversion workflow.
verification.limits: No claim that normal conversion settings produce K=9.

verification.description: Computed packed dimension 144 and table index 8 for K=9.
verification.limits: Arithmetic only; no native out-of-bounds access or GPU launch was executed.
